# sustain_udp_monitor (Resource)

A UDP port's monitor: what it sends to its host's port, sent again while no reply comes, and what the reply must hold.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# An NTP server, asked the time.
resource "sustain_udp_monitor" "time" {
  name   = "Time"
  config = { host = "time.example.com", port = 123, encoding = "hex", send = "1b000000" }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `config` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--config))
- `name` (String)

### Optional

- `check_areas` (List of String)
- `check_interval_seconds` (Number)
- `confirmed_by` (String) What confirms a monitor's failed round: verification rounds, each about 15 seconds after the last, or its next scheduled rounds, with no check between them.
- `domain_expiry_alert_days` (Number) Days before it expires that the alert policy is told, as an incident; null for none watched. 30 when it isn't given, as Terraform can't ask for null.
- `enabled` (Boolean)
- `failure_threshold` (Number)
- `metadata` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--metadata))
- `places_to_fail` (Number) Its quorum: how many places failing together fail a round, or every place while fewer answer.
- `private_locations` (List of String) The workspace's private locations it's checked from too, or alone with no `check_areas`, by id, ten at most: none unless given.
- `recovery_threshold` (Number)
- `sla_target_percent` (Number) 99.9 when it isn't given, as Terraform can't ask for null.
- `status_page_visibility` (String) Whether a monitor is shown on the status page.
- `timeout_ms` (Number)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The monitor's id.
- `version` (Number) Its version, which a change must name, as its last read.

<a id="nestedatt--config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `config`

Required:

- `host` (String)
- `port` (Number)
- `send` (String) What it sends, a datagram, as its encoding writes it: at most 512 bytes, text's only control characters tabs and line breaks. Required: a UDP server answers only what it's sent.

Optional:

- `encoding` (String) How send and expect are written: text, as UTF-8; or hex, two digits a byte.
- `expect` (String) What the server must say, first or in reply to what was sent, as its encoding writes it: at most 256 bytes, text with no control characters. Null connects alone.


<a id="nestedatt--metadata"></a>
### Nested Schema for `metadata`

Required:

- `key` (String)
- `value` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# By its id in Sustain, as its page in the console, or its API, gives it.
terraform import sustain_udp_monitor.time <id>
```
